name: Two Sidon sets with disjoint difference sets
description: construct() -> [A,B], two nonempty Sidon subsets of [1,n=256], at most 64 elements each. Pair sums inside each set, including a+a, must be unique. Their nonzero difference sets must be disjoint. Maximize |A|+|B|; A and B need not themselves be disjoint. Two Sidon subsets of [1,256]; maximize combined size and require disjoint nonzero differences. Ordinary Sidon diagonals are included, and the two sets themselves may overlap.

state_of_the_art.statement: No documented maximum of |A| + |B| for N = 256. Erdős's question (Problem #43) was answered negatively: one Sidon set can have the maximum size while the other grows without bound.
